subject: Invoice origin & delivery — who issues? (Acme PO 789)
messages:
From: Lina Park <billing@acmesolutions.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Invoice origin & delivery — who issues? (Acme PO 789)

Hi Jonas,

We're getting ready to process PO #789 for the pilot usage charges. A couple of questions from AP before we can accept:

- Who will be the invoice originator on the document? Our AP policy requires the invoice to be issued by the vendor of record. Can Redwood issue the invoice with "Redwood Inference" as the issuer and "Acme Solutions" as the bill-to?
- Delivery preference: we have an SFTP-based AP portal for invoice ingestion and prefer machine-readable filenames and an XML attachment where possible. If that's not supported yet, we need a signed PDF to the AP mailbox (ap@acmesolutions.com).
- VAT/Tax: please include VAT breakdown and Redwood's tax ID on the invoice. We may need VAT evidence (EU VAT certificate) attached.

Attaching the PO for reference. Please confirm whether Redwood will generate the invoice and the expected delivery channel.

Thanks,
Lina Park
AP Specialist
Acme Solutions
(Attachment: PO_Acme_789.pdf)

From: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Lina Park <billing@acmesolutions.com>
Cc: connor_obrien@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-11T10:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice origin & delivery — who issues? (Acme PO 789)

Hi Lina — thanks for the clear note and the PO. Short answers up front: Redwood can issue the invoice as the vendor of record (Redwood Inference), set "Acme Solutions" as Bill-To, and we support both portal SFTP push and email PDF copies. We also can include a VAT breakdown and attach VAT evidence if you provide the certificate/ID.

Couple of implementation details so we can finalize:
1) Delivery format — portal push (SFTP) with an XML UBL payload is possible, but that requires a short onboarding (API key + filename convention). If you prefer a signed PDF to ap@acmesolutions.com only, we can do that immediately. Email copies can be sent to a separate ops mailbox if you want (e.g., ap+ops@acmesolutions.com).
2) PO placement — we'll reference PO #789 on the invoice line items and in filename for portal ingestion.
3) VAT evidence — please attach your VAT certificate or provide your VAT registration number and country code. For EU customers we will tag reverse-charge where appropriate but will need your guidance if Acme expects reverse-charge or Redwood to charge VAT.
4) Remit & payment terms — please confirm if you require NET30 and whether bank account/SEPA details need to appear on the invoice or will be handled separately.

Connor (AP onboarding) and Kimberly (billing ops) are looped to drive the portal option and the invoice template. Proposed next steps:
- Lina: confirm portal vs signed-PDF and share VAT cert or VAT number.
- Connor: if portal, schedule onboarding and share SFTP host/key requirements.
- Kimberly: prep invoice draft with PO and VAT breakdown for Lina to review.

Happy to jump on a quick 15-min call if helpful.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

---

jonas_weber@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

From: Lina Park <billing@acmesolutions.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: ap@acmesolutions.com
Date: 2026-08-12T08:55:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice origin & delivery — who issues? (Acme PO 789)

Hi Jonas (and team),

Thanks for the clarity. We'd prefer the portal SFTP option to avoid manual uploads. AP can accept either UBL/XML or a standardized PDF with PO in the filename. Our preferences:

- Primary: XML UBL payload pushed to our SFTP, filename pattern: acme_po789_YYYYMMDD.xml
- Secondary: Signed PDF copy to ap@acmesolutions.com (if XML can't be produced this week)
- VAT: Acme's VAT number is ACME-EU-4572 (country: IE). We expect invoices to show VAT breakdown; if Redwood applies reverse-charge, please flag that on the invoice and include the note: "VAT reverse-charge applies—recipient liable."
- Payment terms: NET30, remit to the bank details you have on file for Redwood. If you need us to confirm IBAN/SEPA specifics on the invoice, let us know.

We can start portal onboarding immediately. Connor, can you send the SFTP host/key steps and any sample filename conventions?

Best,
Lina
AP Specialist, Acme Solutions

(See attached PO_Acme_789.pdf)

From: connor_obrien@redwood.ai <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Lina Park <billing@acmesolutions.com>, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-12T10:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice origin & delivery — who issues? (Acme PO 789)

Hi Lina — welcome, and thanks for confirming the portal preference. Quick checklist and timeline from Redwood side: 

- Onboarding: We'll provision an SFTP dropbox for Acme and a template for XML UBL output. I will send a short onboarding packet (host, port, user, key format) within 24 hours. Sample filename convention we use is: redwood_acme_PO789_YYYYMMDD.{xml,pdf}. We can map to your requested acme_po789_YYYYMMDD.xml pattern — please confirm you'd like us to use that exact pattern.
- Invoice origin: Redwood will issue the invoice (Redwood Inference) and set Bill-To as "Acme Solutions" with PO reference included.
- VAT handling: Kimberly, please prepare two invoice templates — one with standard VAT applied and one with the reverse-charge note and zero VAT. Lina, we'll include both and you can confirm which to use for this booking.
- Timeline: Pilot invoice can be issued the week of 2026-08-16 once we have the VAT cert/number and your confirmation on filename convention.

Action items:
1) Lina: confirm filename convention (we can adopt your acme_po789_YYYYMMDD.xml exactly) and share the preferred AP contact email for fallback copies.
2) Lina: confirm VAT cert attached or paste VAT number (you provided ACME-EU-4572 — we'll need the certificate copy for records).
3) Connor: send SFTP packet (I will follow up in a separate email).
4) Kimberly: prep draft invoice and send as PDF for Lina to sign off before portal push.

If helpful, I can coordinate a 15-min handoff call tomorrow at 09:30 PT.

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
Billing & AP Integrations
Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.ai

(Attachment: onboarding_packet_placeholder.txt - will send full SFTP creds via secure channel)
